title: Telemetry Envelope Fidelity Guardian: adaptive schema enforcement with drift mitigation
creator: Maya Patel
description: Goal: Replace brittle strict-schema checks with an envelope-first gatekeeper that enforces high-fidelity telemetry while allowing controlled schema evolution. The service will validate event envelopes (metadata + payload), apply safe migrations for known drift patterns, and surface anomalies for manual triage. This reduces data loss from rejections, keeps downstream analytics correct, and provides clear signals when producers change shapes.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Ingest pipeline rejects <0.1% of traffic for schema-related errors after rollout.
2) Drift alerts fire with actionable diff and example events.
3) Downstream dashboards show <1% metric regression attributable to schema changes.
4) Feature toggle to revert to strict-mode within 15 minutes.
5) Integration tests and canary on dedicated telemetry stream pass.
implementation_notes:
- Introduce an envelope version header (x-telemetry-envelope-v) at the gateway.
- Lightweight schema registry (protobuf/avro + jsonschema fallback) stored in S3 with cached TTLs.
- Two-phase validator: 1) fast structural checks (required fields, types), 2) heuristics for tolerated drift (optional fields added, string->enum widening).
- Safe transformations: rename, coerce numeric strings, normalize timestamps. Transform rules are explicit and auditable.
- Backpressure strategy: when validator queue grows beyond threshold, enable sampling + async revalidation and bubble rate-limited metrics.
- Metrics: validation_rate, rejection_rate, drift_rate, avg_validation_latency, transformer_error_rate.
- Expose a preview API for producers to validate new shapes before rollout.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for schema matcher, transformer rules, and envelope parsing.
- Property tests for random event permutations that must not be silently dropped.
- Integration test: run canary producer that emits known drift patterns (field rename, nested array vs scalar).
- Load test: validate steady-state 5k EPS with P95 validation latency < 50ms.
- Regression tests against historical event samples pulled from S3 archive.
rollout_plan:
1) Deploy validator as a feature-gated service in staging; enable on 1% of production traffic for 48h.
2) Monitor metrics and alert channels; iterate transformation rules.
3) Gradually ramp to 25% then 75% over 3 days, with automated rollback if rejection_rate > 0.5% or latency SLO violated.
4) After 7 days stable at 75%, flip default on for all streams and deprecate old strict-reject flow.
5) Post-mortem and documentation update.
